text: Ctrl + Wheel Zoom（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：通过 Ctrl 或 macOS 的 ⌘ 配合滚轮与键盘快捷键缩放 Harness 网页界面。插件在页面上应用 CSS 缩放，并提供右下角比例控件。支持 50%–200% 范围内以 10% 为步长调整、键盘复位以及浏览器本地记忆缩放比例。适合希望调整 DSH 网页显示大小的用户。需要 DSH Web 客户端；不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

Ctrl + Wheel Zoom (DSH plugin, Web client): Use Ctrl or macOS ⌘ with the wheel or keyboard shortcuts to zoom the Harness interface from 50% to 200% in 10% steps. A corner control shows the level and resets it; the browser remembers the setting locally. No API key or external service is needed.
想把 DSH 网页整体放大或缩小。
能不能用键盘快捷键调整网页显示比例？
I want to zoom the entire DSH web interface with my mouse wheel.
Ctrl + Wheel Zoom 的功能「滚轮和键盘缩放」：按住 Ctrl 或 ⌘ 并滚动滚轮，或用 Ctrl/⌘ +、- 调整网页缩放；Ctrl/⌘ + 0 恢复 100%。范围为 50%–200%，每次变化 10%。
Ctrl + Wheel Zoom 的功能「比例控件与记忆」：页面缩放后，右下角控件显示当前百分比，可用加减按钮逐格调整或点击百分比复位。当前比例写入浏览器 localStorage，并在下次页面加载时恢复。

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Ctrl + Wheel Zoom：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ctrl-zoom)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ctrl-zoom)
[](https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-ctrl-zoom/blob/main/LICENSE)

Hold **Ctrl** (or **⌘** on macOS) and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.
A small chip at the frame's bottom-right corner reports the current level and
returns to 100% in one click.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Features：| Gesture | Result |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + wheel | Zoom in/out in 10% steps, 50%–200% |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `+` / `-` | Same from the keyboard |
| `Ctrl` / `⌘` + `0` | Reset to 100% |
| Bottom-right chip | `−` / `+` step the level; clicking the percentage resets |

The level is remembered in the browser (`localStorage`) and restored on the next
page load. The chip appears only while the level is not 100%, so the frame stays
untouched in the default state.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Install：This is an ordinary DSH **profile bundle**: plain ESM, no build step, no runtime
dependencies. It is published on npm as
[`dsh-ctrl-zoom`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ctrl-zoom) and can also be
installed straight from GitHub.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · From npm (recommended)：1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin**, enter the package name, and install:

```
   dsh-ctrl-zoom
   ```

Or ask the Harness agent:

```
   plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                   target: dsh-ctrl-zoom
   ```

3. If the Web UI was already open, refresh the page once (`Ctrl`/`⌘` + `R`).

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · From a local checkout：```bash
git clone https://github.com/jinmuxi1/dsh-ctrl-zoom.git
```

Then ask the Harness agent:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <absolute path to the cloned directory>
```

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · From a tarball：```bash
npm pack
```

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle
                target: <absolute path to dsh-ctrl-zoom-1.0.0.tgz>
```

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Migrating from `dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom`：If you previously installed the older `dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom` bundle, remove it first:

```
plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
```

That bundle registers its client module under a different id than its package name, so
enabling it fails the Web boot. This package is the maintained replacement.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Uninstall：```
plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle
                target: dsh-ctrl-zoom
```

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Compatibility：- Tested with DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** Web GUI (Electron 44).
- The client half needs a Chromium-based Harness shell. In a non-browser Host it
  is inert.
- No Node dependencies and no install scripts.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · How it works：Zoom is CSS `zoom` on `<html>`. It scales layout, text and fixed overlay layers
together like browser page zoom, while the app's own scroll containers keep
working. A `transform: scale()` wrapper cannot scroll its oversized content, and
a font-size change would only touch text.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · How it works：The wheel listener runs in the capture phase on `window` and calls
`preventDefault()`, so it sees the gesture before app scroll containers and the
browser's native page zoom does not apply a second, independent level. A gesture
another component has already handled (`event.defaultPrevented`, for example an
embedded editor or map with its own `Ctrl`+wheel zoom) is never stolen.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · How it works：Everything is registered through `ctx.effect`: unloading the plugin removes the
chip entry, both listeners, the stylesheet and the applied `zoom` property.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Privacy：The plugin makes no network requests. It reads and writes one `localStorage`
key for the zoom level and applies a CSS `zoom` value to the document element.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Development：Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

```bash
npm run check
```

`check` runs `node --check` on both halves and validates the manifest, locale
metadata, patch reference and the client module id. GitHub Actions runs the same
command on every push and pull request.

dsh-ctrl-zoom README · Files：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: empty `apply()`; the row lets the plugin manager install/toggle the bundle |
| `client.js` | Browser half: gestures, zoom state, chip registration and stylesheet |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader patch inserting the `dsh-ctrl-zoom` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-card title/description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin-manager card artwork |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | Local and CI validation |
dsh-ctrl-zoom README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
